description: What renting a GPU costs per hour. Without arguments: every GPU model with its on-demand range across providers. With a gpu id: every provider, kind (on demand, spot, reserved, marketplace) and machine, cheapest first, each with its source. Prices in mainland China (Alibaba Cloud) come separately, in CNY, with stock per zone. USD per GPU-hour, list and market prices as published, not invoices. A provider that sells whole machines is divided by the machine's GPU count, so its figure includes the CPUs and memory of the machine. Spot, reserved and marketplace prices are different products from on-demand. A price does not say the GPU is in stock. Not purchasing advice.
